For example: /mp:mp01.contoso.com CCMDEBUGLOGGING="1" CCMLOGGINGENABLED="TRUE" CCMLOGLEVEL="0" CCMLOGMAXHISTORY="5" CCMLOGMAXSIZE="10000000" SMSCACHESIZE="15000" SMSSITECODE="XYZ" SMSMP=mp01.contoso.com For more information, see About client installation parameters and properties in Configuration Manager.

parameters.name: InstallClientToDomainController
parameters.description: Set this parameter to specify whether to install the Configuration Manager client on domain controllers: - $true: Always install the client on domain controllers. - $false: Never install the client on domain controllers, unless specified in the Client Push Installation Wizard.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Specifies a name for the client push installation.

parameters.name: RemoveAccount
parameters.description: Specify a string array of client push installation accounts to remove. To remove all accounts, use the ClearAccount parameter.

parameters.name: SiteCode
parameters.description: Specify the three character site code. For example, XYZ.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.

parameters.name: WhatIf
parameters.description: Shows what would happen if the cmdlet runs. The cmdlet doesn't run.

parameters.name: AccessLevel
parameters.description: Specifies a level of allowed remote control access. Valid values are: - FullControl - NoAccess - None - ViewOnly

parameters.name: AddPortalToTrustedSiteList
parameters.description: Don't use this parameter. The application catalog is no longer supported.

parameters.name: AllowClientChange
parameters.description: Indicates whether users can change policy or notification settings in Software Center.

parameters.name: AllowCloudDistributionPoint
parameters.description: Indicates whether a device or user can access content from a cloud-based distribution point.

parameters.name: AllowPortalToHaveElevatedTrust
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow a portal to have elevated trust.

parameters.name: AllowRemoteControlOfUnattendedComputer
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow remote control of a computer with no user logged onto that computer.

parameters.name: AllowUserAffinity
parameters.description: Indicates whether users can define their primary devices.

parameters.name: AllowUserToOptOutFromPowerPlan
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow users to exclude a device from power management settings.

parameters.name: ApplicationCatalogWebsitePointServerName
parameters.description: Don't use this parameter. The application catalog is no longer supported.

parameters.name: AudibleSignal
parameters.description: Specifies what kind of sound a client computer plays while under remote control. This setting does not apply to remote assistance. Valid values are: - None - PlayNoSound - PlaySoundAtBeginAndEnd - PlaySoundRepeatedly

parameters.name: AutoApproveAffinity
parameters.description: Indicates whether the client automatically configures user device affinity from usage data.

parameters.name: BatchingTimeout
parameters.description: Specifies a timeout value, as an integer. Specify a value of Hours or Days by using the *TimeUnit* parameter. When an update deadline passes, Configuration Manager deploys all updates pending within this period.

parameters.name: BrandingTitle
parameters.description: Specifies a Configuration Manager branding title. This branding information helps users identify Configuration Manager as a trusted source.

parameters.name: DeploymentEvaluationSchedule
parameters.description: Specifies a deployment evaluation schedule as a schedule object. To obtain a schedule object, use the New-CMSchedule cmdlet.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Specifies a description for client settings.

parameters.name: DisableFirstSignatureUpdate
parameters.description: Indicates whether to disable the first signature update on client from a remote source.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: DisplayNewProgramNotification
parameters.description: Indicates whether Configuration Manager shows the user notifications for software availability or software installations. If this parameter has a value of $False, the user sees only restart notifications.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable client settings.

parameters.name: EnableBitsMaxBandwidth
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable maximum bandwidth for Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS) background transfers.

parameters.name: EnableComplianceEvaluation
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable compliance evaluation for this client.

parameters.name: EnableDownloadOffSchedule
parameters.description: Specifies whether allow BITS downloads outside of a throttling window.

parameters.name: EnableThirdPartyOrchestration
parameters.description: Specifies whether Software Updates and Software Distribution agents wait for third-party software to install updates and applications. Valid values are: Yes and No.

parameters.name: EnableUserDataAndProfile
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable user data and profile settings.

parameters.name: EnableUserPolicyOnInternet
parameters.description: Indicates whether users receive a user policy when logged on to a computer on the Internet. In order for users to receive user policy, you must enable user polling. You can use the *EnableUserPolicyPolling* parameter to enable user polling. An Internet-based management point must authenticate the user.

parameters.name: EnableUserPolicyOnTS
parameters.description: Use this parameter to enable or disable the client setting, Enable user policy for multiple user sessions.

parameters.name: EnforceMandatory
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enforce all mandatory software update deployments that have deadlines within a specified period of time.

parameters.name: FirewallExceptionProfile
parameters.description: Specifies a firewall exception profile. Valid values are: - Disabled - Domain - Private - Public

parameters.name: ForceScan
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable force scan.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: GrantRemoteControlPermissionToLocalAdministrator
parameters.description: Indicates whether local administrators on the server initiating a remote control connection can establish remote control sessions to this client.

parameters.name: InstallEndpointProtectionClient
parameters.description: Indicates whether to install and enable the Endpoint Protection client on this client if it is not already installed.

parameters.name: InstallRestriction
parameters.description: Specifies which users can initiate an install. Valid values are: - AllUsers - NoUsers - OnlyAdministrators - OnlyAdministratorsAndPrimaryUsers

parameters.name: InventoryReportId
parameters.description: Specifies an inventory report ID.

parameters.name: ManageRemoteDesktopSetting
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow Configuration Manager to manage Remote Desktop sessions for computers.

parameters.name: ManageSolicitedRemoteAssistance
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow Configuration Manager to manage solicited remote assistance sessions.

parameters.name: ManageUnsolicitedRemoteAssistance
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow Configuration Manager to manage unsolicited remote assistance sessions.

parameters.name: MaxTransferRateOffSchedule
parameters.description: Specifies an integer value for maximum transfer rate off schedule.

parameters.name: MaxTransferRateOnSchedule
parameters.description: Specifies an integer value for maximum transfer rate on schedule.

parameters.name: MeteredNetworkUsage
parameters.description: Specifies a type of metered network usage to allow. Valid values are: - Allow - Block - Limit - None

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Specifies a name for a client setting.

parameters.name: NewName
parameters.description: Specifies a new name for a client setting.

parameters.name: NoRebootEnforcement
parameters.description: Applies to version 2006 and later. Configure the client setting Configuration Manager can force a device to restart to prevent devices from automatically restarting when a deployment requires it. By default, Configuration Manager can still force devices to restart. For more information, see device restart notifications.

parameters.name: PassThru
parameters.description: Add this parameter to return an object that represents the item with which you're working. By default, this cmdlet may not generate any output.

parameters.name: PermittedViewer
parameters.description: Specifies an array of names of users who can establish remote control sessions to a client computer.

parameters.name: PortalUrl
parameters.description: Specifies a link, as a URL, for a portal for a client.

parameters.name: PowerShellExecutionPolicy
parameters.description: Specifies how Configuration Manager runs Windows PowerShell scripts on remote computers. Valid values are - AllSigned - Bypass - Restricted The default value is Restricted. When you select Restricted, the Configuration Manager client uses the current Windows PowerShell configuration on the client computer, which determines whether unsigned scripts run.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: Specifies a priority change for a client setting. Valid values are: Decrease and Increase.

parameters.name: PromptUserForPermission
parameters.description: Indicates whether a client computer displays a message asking for user permission before it allows a remote control session.

parameters.name: RemoteAssistanceAccessLevel
parameters.description: Specifies a level of access to assign to remote assistance sessions initiated in Configuration Manager. A user at the client computer always grants permission for a remote assistance session to occur. Valid values are: - FullControl - None - RemoteViewing

parameters.name: RemoveThirdParty
parameters.description: Indicates whether to remove third party.

parameters.name: ReplaceToastNotificationWithDialog
parameters.description: Specify whether to replace toast notifications with a more intrusive dialog window when a deployment requires a restart. It's an optional parameter and false by default.

parameters.name: RequireAuthentication
parameters.description: Indicates whether to use network-level authentication to establish Remote Desktop connections to a client computer.

parameters.name: ScanSchedule
parameters.description: Specifies a scan schedule as a schedule object. To obtain a schedule object, use the New-CMSchedule cmdlet.

parameters.name: Schedule
parameters.description: Specifies a CMSchedule object. To create a CMSchedule object, use the New-CMSchedule cmdlet.

parameters.name: SelectApplicationCatalogWebsitePoint
parameters.description: Don't use this parameter. The application catalog is no longer supported.

parameters.name: ShowNotificationIconOnTaskbar
parameters.description: Indicates whether to display an icon on the taskbar of a client computer to indicate an active remote control session.

parameters.name: ShowSessionConnectionBar
parameters.description: Indicates whether to display a high-visibility session connection bar on a client computer to specify an active remote control session.

parameters.name: SoftwareInventoryFileDisplayName
parameters.description: Specifies the display name to use in place of an inventoried name specified by the *SoftwareInventoryFileInventoriedName* parameter. This parameter allows you to standardize inventory information for software names that differ in different file headers.

parameters.name: SoftwareInventoryFileInventoriedName
parameters.description: Specifies an inventoried manufacturer or product name. During software inventory, Configuration Manager gets inventoried names from header information on client devices.

parameters.name: SoftwareInventoryFileName
parameters.description: Specifies a name for the file you want to collect during inventory. You can use the wildcard (*) to represent any string of text and the question mark (?) to represent any single character.

parameters.name: SuppressReboot
parameters.description: Indicates whether to bypass a required computer restart after installing the System Center 2016 Endpoint Protection client.

parameters.name: SuspendBitLocker
parameters.description: Specifies whether to bypass a required BitLocker Drive Encryption PIN entry when a computer restarts after a software installation. This setting applies only when Configuration Manager initiates a restart. Valid values are: - Always. Configuration Manager temporarily suspends the BitLocker requirement to enter a PIN. - Never. Configuration Manager does not suspend the BitLocker requirement to enter a PIN on the next computer startup after it has installed software that requires a restart. If you select Never, the software installation cannot finish until the user enters the PIN to complete the standard startup process.

parameters.name: TimeUnit
parameters.description: Specifies the unit for the value specified in the *BatchingTimeout* parameter. Valid values are: Hours and Days.

parameters.name: UseUtcForEvaluationTime
parameters.description: Indicates whether to use Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), also known as Greenwich Mean Time, to configure a recurring interval. If you specify $False, Configuration Manager uses local time.
